dialogues.speaker: Kuzmichev
dialogues.text: Hmmm... I need to control the furnace's temperature properly...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to buy a weapon.

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmichev
dialogues.text: Haha, then feel free to browse, dear customer! Quality's guaranteed in this house!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like something made.

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmichev
dialogues.text: Alright, let's hear it. What do you need?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33>I'd like something made...</color>

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmichev
dialogues.text: Sure, have a look. Not to brag or anything, but you won't find a better smith in all Snezhnograd! So, what'll it be?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmichev
dialogues.text: I'm checking the furnace temperature. You've got to nail down those details... even small differences can affect material strength.

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmichev
dialogues.text: Whether a weapon's a success or failure hangs upon those very details.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do I still need weapons if I've got Prime Ice?

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmichev
dialogues.text: Well, that's not the first time I've heard that. The last guy debated me a good long time, too — until I picked up a shovel and patted him lightly on the cheek.

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmichev
dialogues.text: Hah. You should've seen him. So freaked out he could barely summon up an inch of Prime Ice! That shut him up — sent him packing in silence, too.

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmichev
dialogues.text: ...All that to say, dear customer, that there's nothing like having steel in your hand, ready to leap to your defense!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, I'll leave you to it then. See you.

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmichev
dialogues.text: See you. Come again if you need anything!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33>I'd like to buy some weapons.</color>

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmichev
dialogues.text: Haha, then feel free to browse, dear customer! Quality's guaranteed in this house!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything of note nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmichev
dialogues.text: Nearby, you say... No, not much that really caught my eye. Between the furnace and weapons, I've got enough on my plate as is.
